text: What problem does an FHRP such as VRRP solve?
choices: A host has exactly one default gateway address and no mechanism to change it, so the gateway router is a single point of failure
explanation: Two or more routers share a virtual IP and virtual MAC; if the active one fails, a standby takes over both and hosts notice nothing — not even an ARP change. A common design error is putting the FHRP active router and the spanning tree root on different devices.
